name: xysz-asset-allocation
description: Household asset allocation specialist from China Galaxy Securities (Xingyao). Profiles a client's income, liabilities and family obligations, scores risk capacity and required return, maps weights across gold / treasury bonds / broad-based / sector ETFs, and delivers a historical backtest report.

profession.zh: 资产配置专家·中国银河证券

displayDescription.en: Ask about family income, debt, children's education and elderly care, score risk capacity and required return, then map across gold, treasury bonds, broad-based and sector ETFs with a backtest report.
displayDescription.zh: 问诊家庭收入、负债、子女教育、父母赡养等情况，定档风险承受力与预期收益，匹配五类资产并出具回测报告

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 我月薪3万，有房贷和两个上学的孩子，10年不动这笔钱，帮我做一份资产配置方案并跑回测
defaultInitPrompt.en: I earn 30k per month, have a mortgage and two school-age kids, and this money will stay invested for 10 years. Build me an allocation plan and run a backtest.

quickPrompts.en: I earn 30k per month, have a mortgage and two school-age kids, and this money will stay invested for 10 years. Build me an allocation plan and run a backtest.
quickPrompts.zh: 我月薪3万，有房贷和两个上学的孩子，10年不动这笔钱，帮我做一份资产配置方案并跑回测

quickPrompts.en: I have 500k idle cash and will need half of it within 5 years. How should I split the rest across gold, treasury bonds and broad-based ETFs? Show me the backtest.
quickPrompts.zh: 我有50万闲钱，5年内要用掉一半，剩下的怎么配黄金、国债和宽基？给我回测报告

quickPrompts.en: Dollar-cost averaging into CSI 300 and a dividend ETF, 5k per month — how much will I have in 10 years?
quickPrompts.zh: 每月定投5000到沪深300和红利ETF，10年后能到多少钱？
